# DeRoyal Hotspot OS

> DeRoyal Hotspot OS is an enterprise captive portal & MikroTik bandwidth management operating system built for high-speed Wi-Fi hotspot access.

## Primary Domain
- Site URL: https://deroyalhotspot.name.ng/

## Key Features & Information
- [Captive Portal Access](https://deroyalhotspot.name.ng/): High-speed Wi-Fi authentication, auto device re-authentication, voucher activation, and bandwidth access plans.
- [Enterprise Features](https://deroyalhotspot.name.ng/llms-full.txt): Complete operational documentation for network administrators, RADIUS integration, and MikroTik RouterOS API setup.

## System Architecture
- Frontend: Single Page Application with React, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and responsive glassmorphism design.
- Backend: Node.js / Express API powering voucher validation, bandwidth profile management, user sessions, and MikroTik router synchronization.
